extDesc.message: Save the original JPG/PNG a site uploaded, byte-for-byte, instead of the WebP copy. Also finds images hidden under overlays.

actionTitle.message: Save Original Image: settings (right-click an image, or point at it and press the shortcut)

commandSave.message: Save the original of the image under the mouse pointer

toastReload.message: This tab was open before the extension was installed. Reload it once and try again.

toastNoImage.message: No image found under the cursor.

toastNoPointer.message: Move the mouse over an image first, then press the shortcut.

toastWebpOnly.message: No JPG/PNG exists on this site. Saved the {1}{2} as it is ({3}).

toastAnimated.message: It was animated: only the first frame was kept.

toastAsk.message: This site has no JPG/PNG version of this image. Choose what to do in the small window.

errDownload.message: the image could not be downloaded

askTitle.message: This site has no JPG or PNG of this image

askMeta.message: Only a {1} version exists{2}. Converting re-encodes it; keeping it saves the file untouched.

askAnim.message: It's animated: converting keeps only the first frame. Keep the {1} to keep the animation.

askRemember.message: Do this every time (you can change it in the extension's settings)

askExpired.message: This choice expired. Right-click the image again.

optIntro.message: Right-click an image and choose “Save original image”, or point at it and press the shortcut. The extension finds the JPG or PNG the site uploaded and saves that file byte-for-byte, even when the page only shows a WebP.

optFallbackH.message: When the site has no JPG or PNG at all

optFbAsk.message: Ask me each time (a small window)

optFbWebp.message: Save the WebP as it is

optFbPng.message: Convert it to PNG (re-encoded without further loss)

optUnderCursor.message: Also find images hidden under overlays (social sites and galleries where right-click doesn't show image options). This adds the menu item to every right-click.

optUnblock.message: Alt + right-click opens the normal menu on sites that disable right-click

optShowConvert.message: Also show “Convert and save as JPG / PNG” (the items move into a submenu)

optShortcut.message: Keyboard shortcut: point at an image and press {1}.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file (Chrome's “Save as” dialog)

optFolder.message: Folder inside Downloads (leave empty to save in Downloads itself)

optPerSite.message: Put each site in its own subfolder (for example rednose.com.ar)

optWhereH.message: Where it looks for the original

optWhere1.message: Larger copies the page lists itself: zoom and lightbox links, srcset, <picture>, “original file” attributes.

optWhere2.message: Shops and CMSs: Tiendanube/Nuvemshop, Shopify, WooCommerce/WordPress (and WebP plugins, Jetpack), Wix, Squarespace, Magento, PrestaShop, BigCommerce, Ghost, Drupal, Craft, Hugo.

optWhere3.message: Image CDNs and proxies: Cloudinary, imgix, Cloudflare, ImageKit, Uploadcare, Filestack, Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, Netlify, Thumbor, imgproxy.

optWhere4.message: Sites: Amazon, eBay, MercadoLibre, AliExpress, Etsy, Pinterest, X/Twitter, Reddit, Imgur, Flickr, Tumblr, Medium, Behance, ArtStation, Wikipedia, Fandom, YouTube thumbnails, Google/Blogger, Discord, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Apple Music, Last.fm.

optWhere5.message: Everything else: asks the server for JPG/PNG instead of WebP, and tries the same name with a .jpg/.png extension.

optPrivacy.message: Nothing leaves your browser: no analytics, no accounts, no servers. Images are requested only from the site that hosts them.
